about_the_game:
Dive into the ultimate card-based incremental adventure!

Bild your deck by mighty cards, battle with a new HD styled monsters, and evolve your power infinitely.

In Card Storm Idle HD, you are the master of a growing card arsenal. Slay monsters, gather resources, and unlock devastating cards to build an unstoppable deck. Strategically invest in your cards to strengthen their power, push through endless waves of enemies, and discover limitless upgrades. Command the card storm and rain destruction upon your enemies!

Key Features:

  • Power-Boosting Prestige: Unlock the Rebirth system to reset your progress from Stage 1. This strategic sacrifice rewards you with powerful new abilities, permanent Prestige Points, and rare Relics to fuel your next run. 

  • Triple-Threat Combat System: Dominate the battlefield with three distinct attack modes: Click-Damage for active play, Auto-Strike for focused damage on the very left enemy, and Splash Damage to wipe out all monsters at once.

  • Strategic Resource Management: Study your resources and use them to purchase strategic upgrades that permanently enhance your card-based tactics. 

 

  • Meet Epic Challenges: Call for the legendary Titan Flags to aid you in battle and defeat mighty Super Bosses for glorious rewards. 

  • Deep Deck-Building Diversity: Collect a huge variety of unique cards and experiment with synergistic deck forces. The paths to power are thrilling!! 

  • Starting Core Loop: Begin the game by clicking to defeat monsters and earn Gold. Spend your hard-earned Gold to acquire new cards and boost your damage output.

  • Constant Progression: Keep your momentum going! Amplify your power non-stop and crush the monsters before they can even react.

    Ready to build your legacy and command the storm? Download now!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft Widows XP / Vista /7 / 10
  • Processor: 1.2GHz processor
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 8-compadible graphics card with at least 32 Mb of video
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
